(g) Cleaner flow: opened /cleaner, filled name+PIN 1234, tapped [data-testid=cleaner-checkin-btn], 'Your Jobs' section rendered with the seeded active assignment 'TEST_Active / Move Out', both [data-testid=cleaner-photo-add-before] and [data-testid=cleaner-photo-add-after] Upload buttons visible on web (upload picker, not camera — intentional per spec). Cleanup: DELETE /api/cleaners/{TEST_CID} cascaded, review_url restored to empty, admin_login still 200 with tidyups2026. No production /api/quotes writes.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminHistory.js:186-197 — the initial load() runs on mount before cleaners fetch resolves; if cleaners load ever fails, filter chip row still renders with only 'All cleaners' (silent). Consider surfacing a subtle 'Could not load cleaner list' hint instead of a swallowed .catch(() => {}) at line 202.

server.py:1069 — send-review endpoint sets review_sent_at even when sent_via_sms:false (i.e., Twilio not configured). This is intentional per spec but is somewhat misleading: a re-tap of the button shows 'Resend review link' + 'Review sent Nm ago' pill even though NO SMS was actually delivered. Consider only setting review_sent_at when sent==True, OR add a separate sms_sent_at vs review_marked_at to make the audit trail clearer.

server.py:911, 926 — asyncio.create_task(_auto_send_review(...)) is fire-and-forget; if _auto_send_review raises (Twilio hiccup, DB write timing), the exception is swallowed by the event loop with no log entry. Wrap the task body in try/except with logger.exception so retries can be considered later.

AdminHistory.js:73 — HistoryCard doesn't set a stable testID for the whole card (only 'history-card' without item id); if multiple done cards appear in a filter, test scripts can't disambiguate by row. Consider testID={`history-card-${item.id}`}.

CleanerJobs.js — file was not viewed in this iteration but per spec on web uses launchImageLibraryAsync (upload) instead of camera — that's intentional. Please ensure the button label reads 'Upload' (not 'Camera') on web; the seeded screenshot confirms 'Upload' label OK.

carry-over from iter 10-11: server.py still ~1099 lines (mixes quotes/admin/leads/sheets/cleaners/assignments/site-images/PWA/settings/photos/reviews). The new photo-proof + history + reviews block adds ~150 lines — refactor into modules/routers is increasingly worth doing.
carry-over: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning still fires on /admin (React Native Web) — cosmetic only.

review_url validation missing: PUT /api/app-settings accepts ANY string for review_url (empty, 'not-a-url', 'javascript:alert(1)'). Consider a light regex like ^https?:// for defense-in-depth since the value ends up in an SMS body sent to customers.

Minor design nit only: no per-card testID with id suffix on history-card (see review comments).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All three new features work as designed. One design tradeoff worth flagging: review_sent_at is set even when Twilio isn't configured (sent_via_sms:false) — this is by intent (so admin can manually share the link and still track that the workflow was triggered) but it does mean the 'Review sent Nm ago' UI badge is technically inaccurate in preview. Frontend correctly softens the copy via the notice text ('Text messages aren't configured in this environment — share the link manually.'), so the UX is honest. No fix needed unless main agent wants stricter semantics.
